subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding and calculating percentage increase (e.g. tax, tips, growth)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student applies a virtual 'tax added' percent-increase to a price and finds the new total
exercise.pictorial: Student shades a bar model extended beyond the original whole to show a percent increase
exercise.abstract: Student calculates the increase amount and final total given an original value and percent increase

misconception_flags: confuses percentage increase with percentage of the original alone (forgets to add it back)

interest_binding: exercise generated using student's stated interest profile
